text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential. Make a schedule and set small goals so you can track your progress. Next, learn prioritization: decide which tasks are most important and do them first. If a task is too big, use scope management to reduce it to something you can finish on time. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your team or teacher early instead of waiting until the last minute. These four habits help you stay calm, work smarter, and meet your deadlines successfully.
